verification_boundary: Six distinct goals have three dummy stages and three real audit stages. WFA, QFA and SINGULAR-PREMISE OBSTRUCT R3 record pending status without compiler execution, cache restoration or theorem audits. WFB, QFB and SIGNULAR-PREMISE OBSTRUCT T3 select their established exact statements and registered dependency packages for fresh type and transitive-axiom audits. WFB retains its full Fourier-budget hypothesis; the T3 obstruction retains its single StoppedCommutatorBound premise. Auditing that implication does not construct a witness or prove unconditional failure of NSE-B. Complete Material verification remains separate and unchanged.

goals.name: WFA
goals.verification_scope: Dummy stage only: WFA is not yet closed. The listed principal packages are retained foundation candidates; this stage does not audit them or invoke Lean, restore caches, or claim a WFA proof.
goals.retained_foundation_scope: Physical H1 Fourier and six-sector projections, the full stopped enstrophy/Fourier budgets, and their gauge and finiteness equivalences for supplied physical H1 paths. The canonical whole-space NSE trajectory and WFA continuation root are not supplied by these packages.
open_obligations: Construct the actual whole-space local and maximal strong NSE trajectory with its original initial trace.
Prove physical evolution estimates, continuation and comparison for the same trajectory.
Construct the general QFA tail and the strict cutoff-overlap bridge needed by the WFA assembly.
Prove the WFA root with the full improper Fourier budget retained explicitly; universal budget finiteness is a separate obligation.

goals.name: WFB
goals.verification_scope: Actual maximal classical trajectory existence for smooth periodic solenoidal mean-zero data and the exact Weak_Fourierman_B conditional root. Finiteness of the full Fourier-square budget up to min(maximal lifetime, QFB cutoff) remains an explicit hypothesis; the conclusion preserves the original velocity and normalized pressure.
open_obligations: Universal finiteness of the full improper Fourier budget is not proved; the existing WFB theorem retains that hypothesis.
The conditional budget theorem does not establish universal unforced NSE-B regularity.

goals.name: QFA

The target_definition is a proposition definition, not a theorem proving general QFA.

The target_definition is a proposition definition, not a theorem proving general QFA.
open_obligations: Prove the actual sharp whole-space Sobolev admission needed by the frozen cutoff 8*norm(a)^4/(27*pi^4*nu^5).
Construct forced maximal regularity and actual nonlinear local/maximal H1 theory with continuation.
Construct global physical Leray-Hopf solutions for general solenoidal L2 data.
Prove actual whole-space weak-strong comparison and small-product global continuation.
Assemble the general nonzero-data smooth tail, original-gradient energy equality and unique future from every path's own trace, preserving the strict/closed cutoff distinction.

goals.name: QFB
goals.verification_scope: The literal QuasiFeffermanBStatement: physical periodic L2 solenoidal mean-zero data, LH nonemptiness, every specified LH path, smoothness at the safe cutoff and the strict-cutoff smooth-tail, energy-equality and own-trace future-uniqueness clauses. This is the exact established QFB theorem, not universal regularity from time zero.

goals.name: SINGULAR-PREMISE OBSTRUCT R3
goals.verification_scope: Dummy stage only: no native whole-space singular-premise obstruction root is established. The listed packages are generic scalar and commutator foundations; this stage does not audit them or invoke Lean, restore caches, or claim an R3 obstruction theorem.
goals.retained_foundation_scope: Only domain-independent stopped scalar descent and transport/Hamiltonian commutator algebra. These existing generic packages do not define or prove a whole-space NSE-A obstruction and do not instantiate the periodic Galerkin obstruction as an R3 theorem.
open_obligations: Define the actual unforced whole-space NSE-A target and a noncircular single-input obstruction predicate with the intended datum and solution classes.
Construct the whole-space physical approximation/dynamical identification and the required smooth-solution stability bound.
Prove the exact single-input implication to failure of NSE-A; no native root declaration currently exists.
Construct an input satisfying the obstruction predicate separately from proving the conditional implication.

goals.name: SIGNULAR-PREMISE OBSTRUCT T3
goals.verification_scope: The established exact positive-viscosity implication StoppedCommutatorBound nu -> Not (NSE_B nu), together with its initial-front, global-smooth and dynamical reduction theorems. The goal is this conditional single-premise implication. Its stopped-bound premise is retained and concerns one fixed smooth periodic datum and its actual canonical Galerkin family. The audit does not construct a premise witness, prove unconditional failure of NSE-B, or substitute a forced Fefferman-D result.
retained_premises: The single substantive obstruction premise StoppedCommutatorBound nu.
separate_open_obligations: Constructing a witness of StoppedCommutatorBound for an actual fixed smooth datum is separate from this established conditional implication and remains unproved.
A complete Hilbert-operator realization remains a separate milestone and is not supplied by the scalar conditional root.
Unconditional failure of unforced NSE-B is not established by the accepted conditional reduction.
